wishes.name: Sh. Inder Pal & Smt. Nirmala
wishes.message: Dearest Abhinav and Mansi, our heartfelt blessings are always with you both. May Lord Ganesha shower your new journey with endless joy, peace, and eternal togetherness.

wishes.name: The Sharma Family
wishes.message: Mansi our beloved daughter, and Abhinav our wonderful son-in-law, watching you two step into this sacred chapter fills our hearts with pride and pure bliss.
